structured_output.summary: The change implements Array.prototype.with in prototype_with.rs in spec order: ToObject, LengthOfArrayLike, ToAbsoluteIndex, the RangeError check, ArrayCreate, then the loop with Get only for k != actualIndex and CreateDataPropertyOrThrow for each index. Abrupt completions propagate with `?`. A local to_absolute_index helper follows ToAbsoluteIndex, including the finite-negative adjustment. The only deviation is the use of `?` where the spec has `!` on CreateDataPropertyOrThrow. That is harmless because the array is fresh and extensible, and ArrayCreate already rejects lengths above 2^32-1. No test-shaped branches, no fake values, and no unrelated edits. The gate report is clean.
structured_output.notes_for_next_attempt: No defects found. Optional follow-up: the local to_absolute_index helper in prototype_with.rs could move into kahvi_core::ops once other array built-ins (e.g. toSpliced, slice, copyWithin, fill) need it, so it is not duplicated.
